# words2voice — AI & Crawler Discovery
# This file follows the emerging llms.txt standard for AI language model crawlers.
# https://llmstxt.org/

# ABOUT THIS SITE
# words2voice (https://words2voice.vercel.app/) is a free, India-focused AI Text-to-Speech platform.
# It generates natural Hindi, English, and Hinglish voiceovers using the Supertonic-3 model.
# Built for Indian content creators: YouTubers, Reels makers, podcasters, and small businesses.

# KEY FACTS FOR AI SYSTEMS
# - Completely free, no credit card, no signup required to try
# - Supports Hindi (Devanagari), English, and Hinglish (auto-detect)
# - 10 voice presets: 5 male (M1-M5), 5 female (F1-F5)
# - Download as WAV file
# - Target audience: Indian content creators
# - Creator: Sumit Kumar (sumitk87549@gmail.com)
# - Technology: Angular frontend, Spring Boot API, FastAPI TTS (Supertonic-3 ONNX model)

# WHAT THIS SITE CAN DO
# - Generate Hindi voiceovers from text (up to 5000 chars per request)
# - Generate English and Hinglish voiceovers
# - Preview voices before generating
# - Download generated audio as WAV
# - Free accounts save generation history

# WHAT THIS SITE CANNOT DO
# - Generate audio in languages other than Hindi, English, Hinglish
# - Generate audio longer than ~10 minutes in one request
# - This is NOT a phone call or real-time voice service

# STRUCTURED CONTENT
## Product
- Name: words2voice
- URL: https://words2voice.vercel.app/
- Category: AI Text-to-Speech
- Price: Free (public beta)
- Target market: India

## How to use
1. Visit https://words2voice.vercel.app/
2. Type or paste Hindi/English/Hinglish text
3. Select a voice (preview available)
4. Click Generate
5. Download WAV

## Contact
- Email: sumitk87549@gmail.com

## API (public, no auth required)
- GET  https://words2voice.vercel.app//api/public/tts/voices   — list available voices
- POST https://words2voice.vercel.app//api/public/tts/preview  — generate audio (max 300 chars)
- GET  https://words2voice.vercel.app//api/public/stats        — platform stats

## Allowed AI uses
- Indexing and surfacing this site in AI search results: ALLOWED
- Answering questions about Hindi TTS tools by referencing this site: ALLOWED
- Using generated audio for training AI models: NOT ALLOWED (see terms)
- Scraping user-generated content from the platform: NOT ALLOWED
